title: Overlord Mata Muram
summary: Overlord Mata Muram tests gaze reactions and add control through several health stages.
overview: Mata Muram requires fast personal reactions to his gaze, control of recurring adds, and a planned return after the raid is banished. Defeat Vangl before starting the initial dialogue.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Keep the boss and recurring enemies controlled through each transition.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: React immediately to personal gaze and buzzing warnings.

roles.label: Healers and support
tips: Prepare mark removal for the short fifteen-second resolution window.

phases.label: Opening assault
phases.description: Control the coerced lieutenants and recurring lashers while responding to gaze warnings.

phases.label: Mark of Death
phases.description: The boss applies marks to randomly selected clients and checks for remaining marks fifteen seconds later.

phases.label: Converts
phases.description: Two languished converts appear. Collect and defeat them.

phases.label: Riftseeker intervention
phases.description: Four riftseekers appear and restrain Mata Muram. Banishment follows after sixty seconds, or sooner if his health falls below 20%.

phases.label: Return and finish
phases.description: The raid is moved away and Mata Muram retains his remaining health. Return correctly, reactivate him through dialogue and finish the encounter.

abilities.name: Mata Muram's Gaze
abilities.summary: A selected player has ten seconds to prepare Reflective Skin.
description: The script checks the selected player for Reflective Skin when the warning expires.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: When personally warned of the gaze, obtain Reflective Skin before ten seconds pass.
A buzzing warning leads to five lashers at the selected player after six seconds; have add control ready.
At 70%, remove Mark of Death before its fifteen-second check.
After banishment, return through the encounter's intended route and use the boss dialogue to resume the fight.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
